acceptanceCriteria: An owning spec (index-snapshot-v0 or agent-harness-integration-v0) records the chosen automatic refresh mechanism as numbered requirements with non-goals, failure modes and rollback, accepted by the owner.

After a content commit or a main move in an enrolled repository, the next hook event after the refresh completes reports a fresh snapshot with no manual `corvint index --if-stale`; a regression test covers commit-then-event.
Concurrent triggers start at most one refresh per tree; a failed or killed refresh leaves no partial snapshot and the hook still fails open with the stale code and the manual argv.
The hook event itself stays within its declared work bound; the refresh runs outside it and exits when done (no permanent daemon).
body: Observed 2026-10-10 on the Corvint primary checkout (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 local build from origin/main 3beedd98; corvint-tasks build 407; Claude Code adapter). Reproduction: after main moves (a merge or fetch-and-checkout) or after any content commit, every Claude Code hook event (UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart, PreCompact) reports `Corvint FALLBACK degraded: corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-index-snapshot-stale` and tells the user to 'Refresh the snapshot once, outside the hook: corvint --root <repo> index --if-stale'. The user had to paste the notice and the agent had to run the command by hand; it built the snapshot for tree bd9760a0 in about 3 s and evicted one old snapshot. Owner feedback: 'this should be automatic.' V1-0286 (COMPLETED) fixed the cause naming and the remediation argv (IDX-SNAP-V0-012, decision 0049 keeps the hook from building synchronously inside its 1.5 s work bound) but left the refresh manual. Expected: when the hook observes a stale snapshot it (or an installed host lifecycle step) triggers a bounded, detached, single-flight `index --if-stale` outside the hook deadline, so the next event finds a fresh snapshot without user action. Candidate shapes, to be decided spec-first: (a) the hook spawns a detached, lock-guarded `index --if-stale` child and still fails open for the current event; (b) an opt-in git post-commit/post-merge/post-checkout hook installed by `corvint init`/adopt; (c) SessionStart triggers the refresh in the background. Constraints: product invariant 4 (read commands do not mutate repository or trace state) and invariant 7 (no permanent daemon) apply; the snapshot is derived state under .corvint, so the spec must state whether a hook-triggered refresh is admitted and bound its CPU, concurrency (one refresh per tree), disk eviction and load behaviour (HLQ envelope from V1-1120).

Tests named in the PR: cmd/corvint SnapshotRefresh* -race (commit-then-event, single-flight, stale lock), ./internal/contextindex. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). title: hooks: refresh a stale index snapshot automatically instead of asking the user to run index --if-stale
